channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Leonardo cited as why defence must not be sidelined
item.description: The Leonardo helicopter operation in Yeovil was cited in Parliament as an example of how environmental, social and governance requirements risk undermining Britain’s defence industry if they are not matched by firm government procurement decisions. The post Leonardo cited as why defence must not be sidelined first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: China quietly funding Russian war machine MPs told
item.description: China is providing decisive economic and technological backing to the Russian war effort in Ukraine, effectively sustaining the Russian ability to continue the conflict while avoiding overt military involvement, defence experts told MPs this week. The post China quietly funding Russian war machine MPs told first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK defence must move beyond steel-era procurement, MPs told
item.description: Air Marshal (Retd) Edward Stringer has warned that the UK is still designing forces around Cold War-era assumptions centred on large platforms and prolonged specification cycles. The post UK defence must move beyond steel-era procurement, MPs told first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK explores stronger underwater protection for naval bases
item.description: Britain is examining ways to strengthen underwater security around naval bases and ports as part of a broader effort to protect critical maritime infrastructure, according to new parliamentary answers from the Ministry of Defence. The post UK explores stronger underwater protection for naval bases first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ferguson Marine cited as key voice in civil shipbuilding future
item.description: Port Glasgow shipbuilder Ferguson Marine has been identified as a significant contributor to Scotland’s civil shipbuilding sector in a new report by the House of Commons Scottish Affairs Committee. The post Ferguson Marine cited as key voice in civil shipbuilding future first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Drones are reshaping warfare faster than doctrine adapts
item.description: The war in Ukraine has demonstrated that drones and autonomous systems are transforming warfare at a pace that risks outstripping traditional military thinking, defence experts warned MPs. The post Drones are reshaping warfare faster than doctrine adapts first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK troops train for combat in live-fire Falklands exercise
item.description: An infantry company from the Royal Irish Regiment has completed its final major training exercise in the Falkland Islands, using the remote South Atlantic territory as a demanding test of soldier endurance, navigation and self-sufficiency. The post UK troops train for combat in live-fire Falklands exercise first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Norway could get in build Royal Navy Type 26 Frigate
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has for the first time officially confirmed that Type 26 frigate build slots currently allocated to the Royal Navy are being assessed for potential transfer to Norway. The post Norway could get in build Royal Navy Type 26 Frigate first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American forces strike Syria hitting terror sites
item.description: US Central Command said American forces carried out five strikes against Islamic State targets in Syria between 27 January and 2 February, destroying what it described as a communications site, logistics node and weapons storage facilities. The post American forces strike Syria hitting terror sites first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RFA confirms 3-month crewing is optional, not default
item.description: Wording on the recruitment website for the RFA suggested that a three-month rotation was the default, that has now been removed. The post RFA confirms 3-month crewing is optional, not default first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
